title.zh: 卷八十八 列傳第十八: 蕭敵烈 耶律盆奴 蕭排押 耶律資忠 耶律瑤質 耶律弘古 高正 耶律的琭 大康乂
title.en: Volume 88 Biographies 18: Xiao Dilie, Yelu Pennu, Xiao Paiya, Yelu Zizhong, Yelu Yaozhi, Yelu Honggu, Gao Zheng, Yelu Delu, Da Kangyi
title.raw: 卷八十八 列傳第十八: 蕭敵烈 耶律盆奴 蕭排押 耶律資忠 耶律瑤質 耶律弘古 高正 耶律的琭 大康乂 Volume 88 Biographies 18: Xiao Dilie, Yelu Pennu, Xiao Paiya, Yelu Zizhong, Yelu Yaozhi, Yelu Honggu, Gao Zheng, Yelu Delu, Da Kangyi

sentences.zh: 蕭敵烈

translations.literal: Xiao Dilie
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Dilie

translations.literal: (Balaci has a separate biography)〉
translations.idiomatic: (See the biography of Balaci)〉

sentences.zh: 耶律盆奴蕭排押

translations.literal: Yelü Pennu, Xiao Paiya
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Pennu and Xiao Paiya

sentences.zh: 〈（恒德匹敵）〉

translations.literal: (Hengde and Pike have separate biographies)〉
translations.idiomatic: (See the biographies of Hengde and Pike)〉

sentences.zh: 耶律資忠耶律瑤質耶律弘古高正耶律的錄大康乂

translations.literal: Yelü Zizhong, Yelü Yaozhi, Yelü Honggu, Gao Zheng, Yelü Delu, Da Kangyi
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Zizhong, Yelü Yaozhi, Yelü Honggu, Gao Zheng, Yelü Delu, and Da Kangyi

sentences.zh: 蕭敵烈，字涅魯袞，宰相撻烈四世孫。

translations.literal: Xiao Dilie, style name Nielugun, was a fourth-generation descendant of Chancellor Talie.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Dilie, whose style name was Nielugun, was a fourth-generation descendant of Chancellor Talie.

sentences.zh: 識度弘遠，為鄉里推重。

translations.literal: His breadth of vision was far-reaching, and he was esteemed in his home district.
translations.idiomatic: He was far-sighted and widely respected in his home district.

sentences.zh: 始為牛群敞史。

translations.literal: He began as Herald of the Cattle Herds.
translations.idiomatic: He began his career as Herald of the Cattle Herds.

sentences.zh: 帝聞其賢，召入侍，遷國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of his worth, he summoned him to attend at court and promoted him to Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of his talent, he summoned him to attend at court and promoted him to Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan.

sentences.zh: 統和二十八年，帝謂群臣曰：「高麗康肇弒其君誦，立誦族兄詢而相之，大逆也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, the emperor said to his ministers: "Goryeo's Kang Zhao murdered his lord Song and installed Song's clansman Sun as king while serving as his minister—this is supreme treason.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, the emperor told his ministers: "In Goryeo, Kang Zhao murdered King Song and installed Song's clansman Sun as king while serving as his minister. This is the gravest treason.

sentences.zh: 宜發兵問其罪。」

translations.literal: We should send troops to call him to account for his crime."
translations.idiomatic: We ought to send troops to demand an accounting for his crime."

sentences.zh: 群臣皆曰可。

translations.literal: All the ministers said this was right.
translations.idiomatic: All the ministers agreed.

sentences.zh: 敵烈諫曰：「國家連年征討，士卒抏敝。

translations.literal: Dilie remonstrated, saying: "The state has campaigned year after year, and the soldiers are worn out.
translations.idiomatic: Dilie remonstrated: "The state has fought campaign after campaign, and the troops are exhausted.

sentences.zh: 況陛下在諒陰，年谷不登，創痍未復。

translations.literal: Moreover, Your Majesty is in mourning, the harvests have failed, and the wounds of war are not yet healed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Your Majesty is still in mourning, the harvests have been poor, and the scars of war have not yet healed.

sentences.zh: 島夷小國，城壘完固，勝不為武，萬一失利，恐貽後悔。

translations.literal: That island realm is a small country with stout walls and defenses; victory would not redound to our martial glory, and if we should meet defeat we may come to regret it.
translations.idiomatic: That island kingdom is small, yet its walls and defenses are strong. Victory would add little to our martial renown, while a single setback could bring lasting regret.

sentences.zh: 不如遣一介之使，往問其故。

translations.literal: It would be better to send a single envoy to inquire into the matter.
translations.idiomatic: It would be better to send a lone envoy to inquire into the affair.

sentences.zh: 彼若伏罪則已；

translations.literal: If they submit to judgment, so be it;
translations.idiomatic: If they submit to judgment, well and good;

sentences.zh: 不然，俟服除歲豐，舉兵未晚。」

translations.literal: if not, wait until mourning is ended and the year's grain is abundant—raising troops then will not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: if not, wait until mourning is ended and the harvest is full—then it will not be too late to take the field."

sentences.zh: 時令已下，言雖不行，識者韙之。

translations.literal: Although the order had already been issued and his words were not followed, those of insight approved them.
translations.idiomatic: Although the command had already been issued and his counsel was not adopted, men of judgment approved it.

sentences.zh: 明年，同知左夷離畢事。

translations.literal: The next year he served as Associate Director of the Left Irbi.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he became Associate Director of the Left Irbi.

sentences.zh: 改右夷離畢。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Right Irbi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Irbi.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，率兵巡西邊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaitai he led troops to patrol the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kaitai era he led troops on patrol along the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 時夷離堇部下閘撒狘撲裏、失室、勃葛率部民遁，敵烈追擒之，令復業，遷國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: At that time under the Irbi Chief, the tribal leaders Zhapusa Puli, Shishi, and Boge led their people in flight; Dilie pursued and captured them, had them resume their livelihoods, and was transferred to Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, under the Irbi Chief, the tribal leaders Zhapusa Puli, Shishi, and Boge led their people in flight. Dilie pursued them, captured them, restored them to their livelihoods, and was again appointed Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan.

sentences.zh: 從樞密使耶律世良伐高麗。

translations.literal: He followed Privy Councilor Yelü Shiliang in the campaign against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Privy Councilor Yelü Shiliang on the campaign against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 還，加同政事門下平章事，拜上京留守。

translations.literal: On his return he was made Associate Director under the Gate and Chancellor of the Secretariat, and appointed Regent of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made Associate Director under the Gate and Chancellor of the Secretariat and appointed regent of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 敵烈為人寬厚，達政體，廷臣皆謂有王佐才。

translations.literal: Dilie was by nature magnanimous and versed in government; court officials all said he had the talent to assist a king.
translations.idiomatic: Dilie was magnanimous by nature and well versed in governance; officials at court all said he had the talent to assist a ruler.

sentences.zh: 漢人行宮都部署王繼忠薦其材可為樞密使，帝疑其黨而止。

translations.literal: Wang Jizhong, Chief Deployment Officer of the Han Palace Establishment, recommended that his ability suited him for Privy Councilor, but the emperor suspected faction and did not act.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jizhong, Chief Deployment Officer of the Han Palace Establishment, recommended him as fit for Privy Councilor, but the emperor suspected clique-building and held back.

sentences.zh: 為中京留守，卒。

translations.literal: He served as regent of the Central Capital and died.
translations.idiomatic: He served as regent of the Central Capital and died in office.

sentences.zh: 族子忽古，有傳。

translations.literal: His clansman Hugu has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Hugu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 弟拔剌。

translations.literal: His younger brother Balaci.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Balaci.

sentences.zh: 拔剌，字別勒隱。

translations.literal: Balaci, style name Biele Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Balaci, whose style name was Biele Yin.

sentences.zh: 多智，善騎射。

translations.literal: He was resourceful and skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was clever and skilled in horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 開泰間，以兄為右夷離畢，始補郎君，累遷奚六部禿裏太尉。

translations.literal: During Kaitai, because his elder brother was Right Irbi, he was first appointed Langjun and rose through several posts to Grand Commandant of the Six Xi Tribes Tulü.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaitai period, as his elder brother served as Right Irbi, he was first appointed Langjun and rose through several posts to Grand Commandant of the Six Xi Tribes Tulü.

sentences.zh: 太平末，大延琳叛，拔剌將北、南院兵往討，遇於蒲水，南院兵少卻。

translations.literal: At the end of Taiping, when Dayan Lin rebelled, Balaci led the Northern and Southern Division armies to suppress him; they met at Pushui, and the Southern Division troops were few and fell back.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Taiping era, when Dayan Lin rebelled, Balaci led the Northern and Southern Division armies to suppress him. They met at Pushui, where the Southern Division had fewer troops and fell back.

sentences.zh: 至手山，復與賊遇。

translations.literal: At Mount Shou they again encountered the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Shou they encountered the rebels again.

sentences.zh: 拔剌乃易兩院旗幟，鼓勇力戰，破之。

translations.literal: Balaci then exchanged the banners of the two divisions, roused their courage, and fought fiercely, breaking the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Balaci then exchanged the banners of the two divisions, roused their fighting spirit, and broke the enemy.

sentences.zh: 上聞，以手詔褒獎，賜內廄馬。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he rewarded him with a handwritten edict and bestowed a stallion from the inner stables.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he rewarded him with a handwritten edict and gave him a stallion from the imperial stables.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，遷四捷軍詳穩，謝事歸鄉里。

translations.literal: During Chongxi he was transferred to Detailed Commandant of the Four Swift Armies and resigned to return to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he was made Detailed Commandant of the Four Swift Armies, then resigned and returned to his home district.

sentences.zh: 數歲，起為昭德軍節度使，尋改國舅詳穩，卒。

translations.literal: After several years he was recalled as Military Commissioner of the Zhaode Army, then soon changed to Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later he was recalled as Military Commissioner of the Zhaode Army, soon after made Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan, and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律盆奴，字胡獨堇，惕隱涅魯古之孫。

translations.literal: Yelü Pennu, style name Hudujin, was a grandson of Tiyin Nielugu.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Pennu, whose style name was Hudujin, was a grandson of Tiyin Nielugu.

sentences.zh: 景宗時，為烏古部詳穩，政尚嚴急，民苦之。

translations.literal: During Emperor Jingzong's reign he was Detailed Commandant of the Wugu Tribe; his government was severe and harsh, and the people suffered under it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Jingzong he served as Detailed Commandant of the Wugu Tribe. His rule was harsh and severe, and the people suffered.

sentences.zh: 有司以聞，詔曰：「盆奴任方面寄，以細故究問，恐損威望。」

translations.literal: The responsible office reported this, and an edict said: "Pennu holds a frontier post; to pursue petty matters in inquiry would damage his authority."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible office reported this, and an edict said: "Pennu holds a frontier commission; to pursue him over trifles would damage his authority."

sentences.zh: 尋遷馬群太保。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to Grand Guardian of the Horse Herds.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Grand Guardian of the Horse Herds.

sentences.zh: 統和十六年，隱實燕軍之不任事者，汰之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Tonghe he secretly identified those in the Hidden Elite Yan Army unfit for duty and culled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Tonghe he secretly identified men in the Hidden Elite Yan Army unfit for duty and removed them.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，駕征高麗，盆奴為先鋒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, when the emperor campaigned against Goryeo, Pennu served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, when the emperor campaigned against Goryeo, Pennu served as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 至銅州，高麗將康肇分兵為三以抗我軍：一營於州西，據三水之會，肇居其中；

translations.literal: When they reached Tongzhou, the Goryeo general Kang Zhao divided his forces into three to resist our army: one camp west of the prefecture at the confluence of the Three Waters, with Zhao in the center;
translations.idiomatic: At Tongzhou, the Goryeo general Kang Zhao divided his army into three to resist our forces: one camp west of the prefecture at the confluence of the Three Waters, with Zhao in the center;

sentences.zh: 一營近州之山；

translations.literal: one camp on the hills near the prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: one camp on the hills near the prefecture;

sentences.zh: 一附城而營。

translations.literal: and one camped against the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: and one camped against the city walls.

sentences.zh: 盆奴率耶律弘古擊破三水營，擒肇，李玄蘊等軍望風潰。

translations.literal: Pennu led Yelü Honggu, broke the Three Waters camp, captured Zhao, and the army of Li Xuanyun and others collapsed at the mere sight of them.
translations.idiomatic: Pennu led Yelü Honggu, broke the Three Waters camp, and captured Zhao. The forces of Li Xuanyun and others fled at the sight of them.

sentences.zh: 會大軍至，斬三萬餘級，追至開京，破敵於西嶺。

translations.literal: When the main army arrived, more than thirty thousand heads were taken; they pursued to Kaesong and defeated the enemy at Xiling.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, more than thirty thousand heads were taken. They pursued to Kaesong and defeated the enemy at Xiling.

sentences.zh: 高麗王詢聞邊城不守，遁去。

translations.literal: When King Sun of Goryeo heard that the border cities were lost, he fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Goryeo King Sun heard that the border cities had fallen, he fled.

sentences.zh: 盆奴入開京，焚其王宮，乃撫慰其民人。

translations.literal: Pennu entered Kaesong, burned the royal palace, and then comforted the people.
translations.idiomatic: Pennu entered Kaesong, burned the royal palace, and then reassured the populace.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其功，遷北院大王，薨。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his achievement, transferred him to Grand Prince of the Northern Division, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his achievement and made him Grand Prince of the Northern Division; he later died.

sentences.zh: 蕭排押，字韓隱，國舅少父房之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Paiya, style name Hanyin, was descended from the Lesser Father House of the Imperial Maternal Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Paiya, whose style name was Hanyin, was descended from the Lesser Father House of the Imperial Maternal Clan.

sentences.zh: 多智略，能騎射。

translations.literal: He was full of stratagems and skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was resourceful in stratagem and skilled in horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 統和初，為左皮室詳穩，討阻卜有功。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he was Detailed Commandant of the Left Pishi and achieved merit in campaigns against the Zubu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tonghe he was Detailed Commandant of the Left Pishi and won merit campaigning against the Zubu.

sentences.zh: 四年，破宋將曹彬、米信兵於望都。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he defeated the Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Wangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he defeated the Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Wangdu.

sentences.zh: 凡軍事有疑，每預參決。

translations.literal: Whenever military affairs were in doubt, he was regularly consulted in the decision.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever military affairs were in doubt, he was regularly called in to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 尋總永興宮分糺及舍利、拽剌、二皮室等軍，與樞密使耶律斜軫收復山西所陷城邑。

translations.literal: Soon he took overall command of the Yongxing Palace Division troops and the Shali, Zhuala, and two Pishi armies, and with Privy Councilor Yelü Xiezhen recovered the prefectures and districts lost in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he took overall command of the Yongxing Palace Division troops together with the Shali, Zhuala, and two Pishi armies, and with Privy Councilor Yelü Xiezhen recovered the prefectures and districts lost in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 是冬，攻宋，隸先鋒，圍滿城，率所部先登，拔之，改南京統軍使。

translations.literal: That winter, attacking Song, he served under the vanguard, besieged Mancheng, led his own troops in the first ascent, took it, and was made Military Commissioner of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the attack against Song, he served under the vanguard, besieged Mancheng, led his own troops in the first assault, took the city, and was made Military Commissioner of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 尚衛國公主，拜駙馬都尉，加同政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: He married the Princess of Weiguo, was appointed Commandant of Cavalry, and made Associate Director under the Gate and Chancellor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He married the Princess of Weiguo, was appointed Commandant of Cavalry, and made Associate Director under the Gate and Chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十三年，歷北、南院宣徽使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he served in succession as Commissioner of the Southern and Northern Division Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he served in succession as Commissioner of the Northern and Southern Division Court of Palace Attendants.

sentences.zh: 條上時政得失及賦役法，上嘉納焉。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial on the gains and losses of current policy and the tax and corvée laws; the emperor praised and adopted it.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial on the strengths and weaknesses of current policy and on tax and corvée law; the emperor praised and adopted it.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加政事令，遷東京留守。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was made Director of Affairs and transferred to regent of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made Director of Affairs and transferred to regent of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，復攻宋，將渤海軍，下德清軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he again attacked Song, led the Bohai army, and took Deqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he again attacked Song, led the Bohai army, and captured Deqing Army.

sentences.zh: 後蕭撻凜卒，專任南面事。

translations.literal: After Xiao Talin died, he was solely entrusted with southern affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiao Talin died, he was entrusted alone with southern affairs.

sentences.zh: 宋和議成，為北府宰相。

translations.literal: When the Song peace was concluded, he became Chancellor of the Northern Administration.
translations.idiomatic: When peace with Song was concluded, he became Chancellor of the Northern Administration.

sentences.zh: 聖宗征高麗，將兵由北道進，至開京西嶺，破敵兵，斬數千級。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shengzong campaigned against Goryeo, he led troops by the northern route to Xiling west of Kaesong, defeated the enemy, and took several thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shengzong campaigned against Goryeo, he led troops along the northern route to Xiling west of Kaesong, defeated the enemy, and took several thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 高麗王詢懼，奔平州。

translations.literal: King Sun of Goryeo was afraid and fled to Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo King Sun was afraid and fled to Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 排押入開京，大掠而還。

translations.literal: Paiya entered Kaesong, plundered on a great scale, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Paiya entered Kaesong, plundered extensively, and returned.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: The emperor commended him and enfeoffed him as Prince of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended him and enfeoffed him as Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 開泰二年，以宰相知西南面招討使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaitai, as chancellor he was made Commissioner for the Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaitai, while serving as chancellor, he was made Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五年，進王東平。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was advanced to Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was advanced to Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 排押為政寬裕而善斷，諸部畏愛，民以殷富，時議多之。

translations.literal: Paiya's government was lenient yet decisive; the tribes feared and loved him, the people grew prosperous, and opinion at the time greatly praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Paiya governed with leniency yet firm judgment; the tribes both feared and loved him, the people grew prosperous, and contemporaries greatly praised him.

sentences.zh: 七年，再伐高麗，至開京，敵奔潰，縱兵俘掠而還。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he again campaigned against Goryeo; reaching Kaesong, the enemy fled in rout and he led his troops in capture and plunder before returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he again campaigned against Goryeo. Reaching Kaesong, he routed the enemy and led his troops in capture and plunder before returning.

sentences.zh: 渡茶、陀二河，敵夾射，排押委甲仗走，坐是免官。

translations.literal: Crossing the Cha and Tuo rivers, the enemy shot at them from both sides; Paiya cast off armor and arms and fled, and for this was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Cha and Tuo rivers, the enemy shot at them from both flanks. Paiya cast off his armor and arms and fled, and for this was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 太平三年，復王豳，薨。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping he was again made Prince of Bin and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taiping he was again made Prince of Bin and died.

sentences.zh: 弟恒德。

translations.literal: His younger brother Hengde.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Hengde.

sentences.zh: 恒德，字遜寧。

translations.literal: Hengde, style name Xunning.
translations.idiomatic: Hengde, whose style name was Xunning.

sentences.zh: 有膽略而善謀。

translations.literal: He had daring and stratagem and was skilled in planning.
translations.idiomatic: He was bold and resourceful and skilled in planning.

sentences.zh: 統和元年，尚越國公主，拜駙馬都尉，遷南面林牙。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tonghe he married the Princess of Yueguo, was appointed Commandant of Cavalry, and transferred to Southern Division Linya.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tonghe he married the Princess of Yueguo, was appointed Commandant of Cavalry, and transferred to Southern Division Linya.

sentences.zh: 從宣徽使耶律阿沒裏征高麗還，改北面林牙。

translations.literal: Following Imperial Clan Commissioner Yelü Amoli on the campaign against Goryeo, on his return he was changed to Northern Division Linya.
translations.idiomatic: Following Imperial Clan Commissioner Yelü Amoli on the campaign against Goryeo, on his return he was transferred to Northern Division Linya.

sentences.zh: 會宋將曹彬、米信侵燕，耶律休哥與恒德議軍事，多見信用，為東京留守。

translations.literal: When the Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin invaded Yan, Yelü Xiuge and Hengde deliberated on military affairs; he was often trusted and made regent of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin invaded Yan, Yelü Xiuge and Hengde deliberated on military affairs. Hengde was often trusted and made regent of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 六年，上攻宋，圍沙堆，恒德獨當一面。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on the attack against Song, they besieged Shadui; Hengde alone held one face of the siege.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, attacking Song, they besieged Shadui; Hengde alone held one sector of the siege.

sentences.zh: 城上矢石如雨，恒德意氣自若，督將士奪其陴。

translations.literal: Arrows and stones rained on the wall like rain, yet Hengde remained calm in spirit and urged his officers and men to seize the parapet.
translations.idiomatic: Arrows and stones rained on the walls, yet Hengde remained calm and urged his officers and men to seize the parapet.

sentences.zh: 城陷，中流矢，太后親臨視，賜藥。

translations.literal: When the city fell he was struck by a flying arrow; the empress dowager came in person to visit him and bestowed medicine.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was struck by a stray arrow. The empress dowager came in person to visit him and bestowed medicine.

sentences.zh: 攻長城口，復先登，太后益多其功。

translations.literal: Attacking Changcheng Pass, he again led the first ascent; the empress dowager praised his merit all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Changcheng Pass, he again led the first assault; the empress dowager praised his merit all the more.

sentences.zh: 時高麗未附，恒德受詔，率兵拔其邊城。

translations.literal: At that time Goryeo had not yet submitted; Hengde received an edict and led troops to capture its border cities.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Goryeo had not yet submitted. Hengde received an edict and led troops to capture its border cities.

sentences.zh: 王始懼，上表請降。

translations.literal: The king then grew afraid and submitted a memorial requesting surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The king then grew afraid and submitted a memorial requesting surrender.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，賜啟聖竭力功臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year he was granted the title Meritorious Subject Who Exhausts Himself for Qisheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year he was granted the title Meritorious Subject Who Exhausts Himself for Qisheng.

sentences.zh: 從都部署和朔奴討兀惹，未戰，兀惹請降。

translations.literal: He followed Chief Deployment Officer Heshuonu in the campaign against Wunai; before battle was joined, Wunai requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Chief Deployment Officer Heshuonu in the campaign against Wunai. Before battle was joined, Wunai requested surrender.

sentences.zh: 恒德利其俘獲，不許。

translations.literal: Hengde coveted the captives and would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Hengde coveted the captives and would not permit it.

sentences.zh: 兀惹死戰，城不能拔。

translations.literal: Wunai fought to the death and the city could not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Wunai fought to the death and the city could not be taken.

sentences.zh: 和朔奴議欲引退，恒德曰：「以彼倔強，吾奉詔來討，無功而還，諸部謂我何！

translations.literal: Heshuonu deliberated on withdrawing; Hengde said: "Given their stubborn defiance, we have come by imperial edict to chastise them—if we return without achievement, what will the tribes say of us!
translations.idiomatic: Heshuonu deliberated on withdrawing. Hengde said: "They are so stubborn, yet we came by imperial edict to chastise them. If we return without achievement, what will the tribes say of us!

sentences.zh: 若深入多獲，猶勝徒返。」

translations.literal: If we penetrate deep and take much booty, that is still better than returning empty-handed."
translations.idiomatic: If we penetrate deep and take much booty, that is still better than turning back empty-handed."

sentences.zh: 和朔奴不得已，進擊東南諸部，至高麗北鄙。

translations.literal: Heshuonu had no choice; they advanced and attacked the southeastern tribes, reaching the northern marches of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Heshuonu had no choice. They advanced and attacked the southeastern tribes, reaching the northern marches of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 比還，道遠糧絕，士馬死傷者眾，坐是削功臣號。

translations.literal: By the time they returned, the road was long and provisions exhausted; many soldiers and horses died or were wounded, and for this his meritorious title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: By the time they returned, the road was long and provisions were exhausted. Many soldiers and horses died or were wounded, and for this his meritorious title was stripped.

sentences.zh: 十四年，為行軍都部署，伐蒲盧毛朵部。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was Chief Campaign Deployment Officer and campaigned against the Pulü Maoduo tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was Chief Campaign Deployment Officer and campaigned against the Pulü Maoduo tribe.

sentences.zh: 還，公主疾，太后遣宮人賢釋侍之，恒德私焉。

translations.literal: On his return, the princess fell ill; the empress dowager sent the palace woman Xian Shi to attend her, and Hengde had an affair with her.
translations.idiomatic: On his return the princess fell ill. The empress dowager sent the palace woman Xian Shi to nurse her, and Hengde took her privately.

sentences.zh: 公主恚而薨，太后怒，賜死。

translations.literal: The princess died of rage, the empress dowager was angry, and he was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The princess died in anger. The empress dowager was furious and ordered him put to death.

sentences.zh: 後追封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: He was later posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 子匹敵。

translations.literal: His son Pike.
translations.idiomatic: His son Pike.

sentences.zh: 匹敵，字蘇隱，一名昌裔。

translations.literal: Pike, style name Suyin, also called Changyi.
translations.idiomatic: Pike, whose style name was Suyin, was also known as Changyi.

sentences.zh: 生未月，父母俱死，育於禁掖。

translations.literal: Within a month of birth both parents died; he was reared in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month of his birth both parents had died, and he was reared in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 既長，尚秦晉王公主，拜駙馬都尉，為殿前副點檢。

translations.literal: When he grew up he married the Princess of the Qin-Jin King, was appointed Commandant of Cavalry, and made Deputy Chief Inspector of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age he married the Princess of the Qin-Jin King, was appointed Commandant of Cavalry, and made Deputy Chief Inspector of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 統和八年，改北面林牙。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tonghe he was transferred to Northern Division Linya.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tonghe he was transferred to Northern Division Linya.

sentences.zh: 太平四年，遷殿前都點檢，出為國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping he was transferred to Chief Inspector of the Palace Front and went out as Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taiping he was made Chief Inspector of the Palace Front and then appointed Detailed Commandant of the Imperial Maternal Clan.

sentences.zh: 九年，渤海大延琳叛，劫掠鄰部，與南京留守蕭孝穆往討。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the Bohai leader Dayan Lin rebelled and raided neighboring tribes, he went with Nanjing Regent Xiao Xiaomu to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when the Bohai leader Dayan Lin rebelled and raided neighboring tribes, he campaigned with Nanjing Regent Xiao Xiaomu to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 孝穆欲全城降，乃築重城圍之，數月，城中人陰來納款，遂擒延琳，東京平，以功封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: Xiaomu wished to take the whole city by surrender and built heavy fortifications to besiege it; after several months people in the city secretly came to submit, and they captured Dayan Lin; the Eastern Capital was pacified, and for this he was enfeoffed Prince of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaomu wished to secure the city by surrender and built heavy fortifications to besiege it. After several months people inside secretly came to submit, Dayan Lin was captured, the Eastern Capital was pacified, and for this Pike was enfeoffed Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 十一年，聖宗不豫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Emperor Shengzong fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Emperor Shengzong fell ill.

sentences.zh: 先是，欽哀與仁德皇后有隙，以匹敵嘗為後所愛，忌之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Qinai and Empress Rendé had been at odds; because Pike had once been loved by the empress, she resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Qinai and Empress Rendé had been at odds. Because Pike had once been favored by the empress, Qinai resented him.

sentences.zh: 時護衛馮家奴上變，誣後弟浞卜與匹敵謀逆，以皇后攝政，徐議當立者。

translations.literal: At that time the guard Feng Jianu submitted a report of treason, falsely accusing the empress's younger brother Chubuo and Pike of plotting rebellion while the empress dowager held the regency, to deliberate in time who should be enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the guard Feng Jianu submitted a report of treason, falsely accusing the empress's younger brother Chubuo and Pike of plotting rebellion so that the empress might hold the regency, and they might then deliberate who should be enthroned.

sentences.zh: 公主竊聞其謀，謂匹敵曰：「爾將無罪被戮。

translations.literal: The princess secretly heard of the plot and said to Pike: "You will soon be executed without crime.
translations.idiomatic: The princess secretly heard of the plot and said to Pike: "You will soon be put to death though guilty of nothing.

sentences.zh: 與其死，何若奔女直國以全其生！」

translations.literal: Rather than die, why not flee to the Jurchen state to preserve your life!"
translations.idiomatic: Rather than die, why not flee to the Jurchen state and save your life!"

sentences.zh: 匹敵曰：「朝廷詎肯以飛語害忠良？

translations.literal: Pike said: "Would the court truly harm the loyal on mere rumor?
translations.idiomatic: Pike said: "Would the court truly harm the loyal on mere rumor?

sentences.zh: 寧死弗適他國。」

translations.literal: Better to die than go to another country."
translations.idiomatic: I would rather die than go to another country."

sentences.zh: 及欽哀攝政，殺之。

translations.literal: When Qinai took the regency, she killed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Qinai took the regency, she had him killed.

sentences.zh: 耶律資忠，字沃衍，小字劄剌，系出仲父房。

translations.literal: Yelü Zizhong, style name Woyan, childhood name Zhala, was of the Second Father House line.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Zizhong, whose style name was Woyan and childhood name Zhala, came from the Second Father House line.

sentences.zh: 兄國留善屬文，聖宗重之。

translations.literal: His elder brother Guoliu was skilled at letters, and Emperor Shengzong valued him.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Guoliu was skilled at letters, and Emperor Shengzong valued him highly.

sentences.zh: 時妻弟之妻阿古與奴通，將奔女直國，國留追及奴，殺之，阿古自經。

translations.literal: At that time the wife of his wife's younger brother, Agu, had an affair with a slave and was about to flee to the Jurchen state; Guoliu overtook the slave and killed him, and Agu hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Agu, wife of his wife's younger brother, had an affair with a slave and was about to flee to the Jurchen state. Guoliu overtook the slave and killed him, and Agu hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 阿古母有寵於太后，事聞，太后怒，將殺之。

translations.literal: Agu's mother was favored by the empress dowager; when the matter was reported, the empress dowager was angry and was about to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Agu's mother was favored by the empress dowager. When the matter was reported, the empress dowager was furious and was about to have him executed.

sentences.zh: 帝度不能救，遣人訣別，問以後事。

translations.literal: The emperor judged he could not save him, sent someone to bid farewell, and asked about affairs afterward.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor judged that he could not save him, sent someone to bid him farewell, and asked about affairs afterward.

sentences.zh: 國留謝曰：「陛下憫臣無辜，恩漏九泉，死且不朽！」

translations.literal: Guoliu thanked him, saying: "Your Majesty pities my innocence; grace reaching the nine springs—dead, I am not destroyed!"
translations.idiomatic: Guoliu thanked him, saying: "Your Majesty pities my innocence; your grace reaches the nine springs. Dead, I am not destroyed!"

sentences.zh: 既死，人多冤之。

translations.literal: After he died, many considered it a miscarriage of justice.
translations.idiomatic: After he died, many considered it a grave injustice.

sentences.zh: 在獄著《兔賦》、《寤寐歌》，為世所稱。

translations.literal: In prison he composed "Rabbit Rhapsody" and "Songs of Waking and Dreaming," praised by the age.
translations.idiomatic: In prison he composed the "Rabbit Rhapsody" and "Songs of Waking and Dreaming," works praised in his time.

sentences.zh: 資忠博學，工辭章，年四十未仕。

translations.literal: Zizhong was broadly learned, skilled at literary composition, and had not taken office by age forty.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhong was broadly learned and skilled at literary composition, yet had not taken office by the age of forty.

sentences.zh: 聖宗知其賢，召補宿衛。

translations.literal: Emperor Shengzong knew his worth and summoned him to fill a post in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shengzong knew his worth and summoned him to serve in the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 數問以古今治亂，資忠對無隱。

translations.literal: Several times he was asked about order and disorder in past and present; Zizhong answered without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Several times the emperor asked him about order and disorder in past and present times; Zizhong answered without concealment.

sentences.zh: 開泰中，授中丞，眷遇日隆。

translations.literal: During Kaitai he was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief and his favor grew daily.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaitai era he was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief, and imperial favor toward him grew daily.

sentences.zh: 初，高麗內屬，取女直六部地以賜。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Goryeo was an inner dependency, it had been given the lands of the six Jurchen tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Goryeo was an inner dependency, the lands of the six Jurchen tribes had been granted to it.

sentences.zh: 至是，貢獻不時至，詔資忠往問故。

translations.literal: By this time tribute and offerings did not arrive on schedule; an edict ordered Zizhong to go inquire into the cause.
translations.idiomatic: By this time tribute and offerings did not arrive on schedule. An edict ordered Zizhong to go and inquire into the cause.

sentences.zh: 高麗無歸地意。

translations.literal: Goryeo had no intention of returning the land.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo had no intention of returning the land.

sentences.zh: 由是權貴數短於上，出為上京副留守。

translations.literal: For this the powerful often spoke ill of him to the emperor; he was sent out as Deputy Regent of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: For this the powerful often spoke ill of him to the emperor, and he was sent out as Deputy Regent of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 三年，再使高麗，留弗遣。

translations.literal: In the third year he was again sent to Goryeo and detained without being sent back.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was again sent to Goryeo and detained without being allowed to return.

sentences.zh: 資忠每懷君親，輒有著述，號《西亭集》。

translations.literal: Zizhong always yearned for sovereign and kin and would compose writings, titled Collected at the Western Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhong always yearned for sovereign and kin and would compose writings, which he titled Collected at the Western Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 帝與群臣宴，時一記憶曰：「資忠亦有此樂乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor feasted with his ministers; at one point he recalled: "Does Zizhong also have this pleasure?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor feasted with his ministers and at one point recalled: "Does Zizhong also enjoy pleasures such as these?"

sentences.zh: 九年，高麗上表謝罪，始送資忠還。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Goryeo submitted a memorial begging pardon and at last sent Zizhong back.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Goryeo submitted a memorial begging pardon and at last sent Zizhong back.

sentences.zh: 帝郊迎，同載以歸，命大臣宴勞，留禁中數日。

translations.literal: The emperor met him in the suburbs and rode back with him in the same carriage; he ordered the great ministers to feast and reward him and kept him in the palace several days.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor met him in the suburbs and rode back with him in the same carriage. He ordered the great ministers to feast and reward him and kept him in the palace several days.

sentences.zh: 謂曰：「朕將屈卿為樞密，何如？」

translations.literal: He said to him: "I intend to bend you to Privy Councilor—what do you think?"
translations.idiomatic: He said to him: "I intend to appoint you Privy Councilor. What do you think?"

sentences.zh: 資忠對曰：「臣不才，不敢奉詔。」

translations.literal: Zizhong replied: "Your servant is without talent and dares not accept the edict."
translations.idiomatic: Zizhong replied: "Your servant lacks talent and dares not accept the edict."

sentences.zh: 乃以為林牙，知惕隱事。

translations.literal: He was then made Linya and given charge of Tiyin affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Linya and given charge of Tiyin affairs.

sentences.zh: 初，資忠在高麗也，弟昭為著帳郎君，坐罪沒家產。

translations.literal: Earlier, while Zizhong was in Goryeo, his younger brother Zhao was a Registered Langjun; for a crime his family property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while Zizhong was in Goryeo, his younger brother Zhao was a Registered Langjun. For a crime his family property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 至是，乃復橫帳，且還舊產，詔以外戚女妻之。

translations.literal: By this time he was restored to the Horizontal Tent and his former property returned; an edict gave him an imperial maternal-clan woman in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: By this time he was restored to the Horizontal Tent and his former property was returned. An edict gave him a woman of the imperial maternal clan in marriage.

sentences.zh: 是時，樞密使蕭合卓、少師蕭把哥有寵，資忠不背俯附，詆之。

translations.literal: At that time Privy Councilor Xiao Hezhuo and Junior Tutor Xiao Bage were in favor; Zizhong would not bow and follow them and slandered them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Privy Councilor Xiao Hezhuo and Junior Tutor Xiao Bage were in favor. Zizhong would not bow and follow them and spoke against them.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，奪官。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and stripped his office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and stripped him of his office.

sentences.zh: 數歲，出知來遠城事，歷保安、昭德二軍節度使。

translations.literal: After several years he went out to manage affairs at Laiyuan City and served in succession as Military Commissioner of Bao'an and Zhaode armies.
translations.idiomatic: After several years he went out to manage affairs at Laiyuan City and served in succession as Military Commissioner of the Bao'an and Zhaode armies.

sentences.zh: 聖宗崩，表請會葬。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shengzong died, he submitted a memorial requesting to attend the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shengzong died, he submitted a memorial requesting permission to attend the funeral.

sentences.zh: 既至，伏梓宮大慟曰：「臣幸遇聖明，橫被構譖，不獲盡犬馬報。」

translations.literal: When he arrived he prostrated himself before the bier and wailed greatly: "Your servant was fortunate to meet a sage ruler yet was slandered across the board and could not exhaust himself like a dog or horse in service."
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he prostrated himself before the bier and wailed greatly: "Your servant was fortunate to meet a sage ruler, yet was slandered on every side and could not exhaust himself in loyal service like a dog or horse."

sentences.zh: 氣絕而蘇，興宗命醫治疾。

translations.literal: He fainted and revived; Emperor Xingzong ordered physicians to treat his illness.
translations.idiomatic: He fainted and revived. Emperor Xingzong ordered physicians to treat his illness.

sentences.zh: 久之，言國舅侍中無憂國心，陛下不當復用唐景福舊號，於是用事者惡之，遣歸鎮，卒。

translations.literal: After a long while he said the imperial maternal-clan attendant lacked a mind to worry for the state, and that Your Majesty ought not again to use the old title of Tang Jingfu; for this those in power hated him, sent him back to his command, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he said the imperial maternal-clan attendant lacked a mind to worry for the state and that Your Majesty ought not again to use the old title of Tang Jingfu. For this those in power hated him, sent him back to his command, and he died.

sentences.zh: 弟昭，有傳。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zhao has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zhao has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 耶律瑤質，字拔裏堇，積慶宮人。

translations.literal: Yelü Yaozhi, style name Balijin, was a man of the Jiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Yaozhi, whose style name was Balijin, was a man of the Jiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 父侯古，室韋部節度使。

translations.literal: His father Hougu was Military Commissioner of the Shivei Tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hougu was Military Commissioner of the Shivei Tribe.

sentences.zh: 瑤質篤學廉介，有經世誌。

translations.literal: Yaozhi was devoted in learning, upright and self-restrained, and had the will to order the age.
translations.idiomatic: Yaozhi was devoted to learning, upright and self-restrained, and had the will to bring order to the age.

sentences.zh: 統和十年，累遷至積慶宮使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Tonghe he rose through several posts to Commissioner of the Jiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tonghe he rose through several posts to Commissioner of the Jiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 聖宗嘗諭瑤質曰：「聞卿正直，是以進用。

translations.literal: Emperor Shengzong once instructed Yaozhi: "I have heard you are upright, and for this I advance you.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shengzong once instructed Yaozhi: "I have heard you are upright, and for this I advance you.

sentences.zh: 國有利害，爾言宜無所隱。」

translations.literal: Where the state has benefit or harm, in your words you should conceal nothing."
translations.idiomatic: Where the state has benefit or harm, you should speak without concealment."

sentences.zh: 由是所陳多見嘉納。

translations.literal: For this what he presented was often praised and adopted.
translations.idiomatic: For this what he presented was often praised and adopted.

sentences.zh: 上征高麗，破康肇軍於銅州，瑤質之力為多。

translations.literal: When the emperor campaigned against Goryeo and defeated Kang Zhao's army at Tongzhou, Yaozhi's effort counted for much.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor campaigned against Goryeo and defeated Kang Zhao's army at Tongzhou, Yaozhi's effort counted for much.

sentences.zh: 王詢乞降，群臣議皆謂宜納。

translations.literal: King Sun begged to surrender; the ministers deliberated and all said he should be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: King Sun begged to surrender. The ministers deliberated and all said he should be accepted.

sentences.zh: 瑤質曰：「王詢始一戰而敗，遽求納款，此詐耳，納之恐墮其奸計。

translations.literal: Yaozhi said: "King Sun was defeated in a single battle and hastily sought to submit—this is deceit; to accept him may fall into his treacherous scheme.
translations.idiomatic: Yaozhi said: "King Sun was defeated in a single battle and hastily sought to submit. This is deceit; to accept him now may fall into his treacherous scheme.

sentences.zh: 待其勢窮力屈，納之未晚。」

translations.literal: Wait until his strength is exhausted and his power spent—accepting him then will not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: Wait until his strength is exhausted and his power spent—then it will not be too late to accept him."

sentences.zh: 已而詢果遁，清野無所獲。

translations.literal: Before long Sun indeed fled; clearing the countryside, nothing was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Sun indeed fled. They cleared the countryside but took nothing.

sentences.zh: 其眾阻險而壘，攻之不下，瑤質以計降之。

translations.literal: His troops held difficult terrain and built ramparts; the attack could not succeed, and Yaozhi reduced them by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: His troops held difficult terrain and built ramparts. The attack could not succeed, and Yaozhi reduced them by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 擢拜四蕃部詳穩。

translations.literal: He was promoted and appointed Detailed Commandant of the Four Fan Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted and appointed Detailed Commandant of the Four Fan Tribes.

sentences.zh: 時招討使耶律頗的為總官，瑤質恥居其下，上表曰：「臣先朝舊臣，今既垂老，乞還新命，覬得常侍左右。」

translations.literal: At that time Pacification Commissioner Yelü Pode was overall commander; Yaozhi was ashamed to be beneath him and submitted a memorial: "Your servant is an old minister of the former court; now that I am old, I beg to return the new appointment and hope to attend constantly at Your Majesty's side."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Pacification Commissioner Yelü Pode was overall commander. Yaozhi was ashamed to serve beneath him and submitted a memorial: "Your servant is an old minister of the former court. Now that I am old, I beg to return the new appointment and hope to attend constantly at Your Majesty's side."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕不使汝久處是任。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I will not let you long remain in that post."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I will not let you remain long in that post."

sentences.zh: 且命無隸招討，得專奏事到部。

translations.literal: He also ordered that he not be subordinate to the Pacification Commissioner and might memorialize directly on arrival in his district.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered that he not be subordinate to the Pacification Commissioner and might memorialize directly on arrival in his district.

sentences.zh: 戢暴懷善，政績顯著。

translations.literal: He restrained violence and cherished kindness; his administrative achievements were conspicuous.
translations.idiomatic: He restrained violence and cherished kindness. His administrative achievements were conspicuous.

sentences.zh: 卒於官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 耶律弘古，字盆訥隱，遙輦鮮質可汗之後。

translations.literal: Yelü Honggu, style name Penne Yin, was descended from Khan Xianzhi of the Yaolian clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Honggu, whose style name was Penne Yin, was descended from Khan Xianzhi of the Yaolian clan.

sentences.zh: 統和初，嘗以軍事任為拽剌詳穩，尋徙南京統軍使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he was once appointed Detailed Commandant of Zhuala for military affairs, then soon transferred to Military Commissioner of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tonghe he was once appointed Detailed Commandant of Zhuala for military affairs, then soon transferred to Military Commissioner of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十三年，徇地南鄙，克敵於四嶽橋，斬首百餘級。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he raided the southern marches, defeated the enemy at Siyue Bridge, and took more than a hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he raided the southern marches, defeated the enemy at Siyue Bridge, and took more than a hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 攻宋，以戰功遷東京留守，封楚國公。

translations.literal: Attacking Song, he was transferred for military achievement to regent of the Eastern Capital and enfeoffed Duke of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On the attack against Song he was transferred for military achievement to regent of the Eastern Capital and enfeoffed Duke of Chu.

sentences.zh: 後伐高麗，副先鋒耶律盆奴，擒康肇於銅州。

translations.literal: Later, campaigning against Goryeo, he served as deputy to vanguard Yelü Pennu and captured Kang Zhao at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later, campaigning against Goryeo, he served as deputy to vanguard Yelü Pennu and captured Kang Zhao at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 三十年，西北部叛，從南府宰相耶律奴瓜討之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year the northwest rebelled; he followed Southern Administration Chancellor Yelü Nugua to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year the northwest rebelled. He followed Southern Administration Chancellor Yelü Nugua to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 及典禁軍，號令整肅，諸部多降。

translations.literal: When he took charge of the forbidden army, his orders were strict and orderly, and many tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When he took charge of the forbidden army, his orders were strict and orderly, and many tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 尋遷侍中，卒。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Attendant-in-Chief and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Attendant-in-Chief and died.

sentences.zh: 高正，不知何郡人。

translations.literal: Gao Zheng—his native commandery is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Zheng—his native commandery is unknown.

sentences.zh: 統和初，舉進士第，累遷樞密直學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he passed the jinshi examination and rose through several posts to Academician Direct of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tonghe he passed the jinshi examination and rose through several posts to Academician Direct of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 上將伐高麗，遣正先往諭意。

translations.literal: When the emperor was about to campaign against Goryeo, he sent Zheng ahead to announce his intent.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to campaign against Goryeo, he sent Zheng ahead to announce his intent.

sentences.zh: 及還，遷右僕射。

translations.literal: On his return he was transferred to Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was transferred to Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 時高麗王詢表請入覲，上許之，遣正率騎兵千人迓之。

translations.literal: At that time Goryeo King Sun memorialized requesting to come to court; the emperor permitted it and sent Zheng with a thousand cavalry to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Goryeo King Sun memorialized requesting to come to court. The emperor permitted it and sent Zheng with a thousand cavalry to meet him.

sentences.zh: 館於路，為高麗將卓思正所圍。

translations.literal: He was lodged on the road and was surrounded by the Goryeo general Zhuo Sizheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was lodged on the road and was surrounded by the Goryeo general Zhuo Sizheng.

sentences.zh: 正以勢不可敵，與麾下壯士突圍出，士卒死傷者眾。

translations.literal: Zheng judged the force could not be resisted; with stalwart men under him he broke through the encirclement, and many soldiers died or were wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng judged the force could not be resisted. With stalwart men under him he broke through the encirclement, and many soldiers died or were wounded.

sentences.zh: 上悔輕發，釋其罪。

translations.literal: The emperor regretted having sent lightly and remitted his crime.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor regretted having acted rashly and remitted his crime.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷工部侍郎，為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Works and made Deputy Privy Councilor of the Northern Division.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Works and made Deputy Privy Councilor of the Northern Division.

sentences.zh: 開泰五年卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kaitai he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Kaitai he died.

sentences.zh: 耶律的錄，字耶寧，仲父房之後。

translations.literal: Yelü Delu, style name Yening, was of the Second Father House line.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Delu, whose style name was Yening, came from the Second Father House line.

sentences.zh: 習兵事，為左皮室詳穩。

translations.literal: He studied military affairs and was Detailed Commandant of the Left Pishi.
translations.idiomatic: He studied military affairs and served as Detailed Commandant of the Left Pishi.

sentences.zh: 統和二十八年，伐高麗，的錄率本部軍與盆奴等擒康肇、李玄蘊於銅州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, campaigning against Goryeo, Delu led his own division army with Pennu and others and captured Kang Zhao and Li Xuanyun at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, on the campaign against Goryeo, Delu led his own division army together with Pennu and others and captured Kang Zhao and Li Xuanyun at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝壯之曰：「以卿英才，為國戮力，真吾家千里駒也！」

translations.literal: The emperor praised him, saying: "With your outstanding talent exerted for the state, you are truly our family's thousand-li colt!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him, saying: "With your outstanding talent exerted for the state, you are truly our family's thousand-li colt!"

sentences.zh: 乃賜御馬及細鎧。

translations.literal: He then bestowed an imperial horse and fine armor.
translations.idiomatic: He then bestowed an imperial horse and fine armor.

sentences.zh: 明年，為北院大王，出為烏古敵烈部都詳穩。

translations.literal: The next year he was made Grand Prince of the Northern Division and went out as Overall Detailed Commandant of the Wugu and Dilie Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was made Grand Prince of the Northern Division and went out as Overall Detailed Commandant of the Wugu and Dilie Tribes.

sentences.zh: 年七十二卒。

translations.literal: He died at age seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 大康乂，渤海人。

translations.literal: Da Kangyi was a man of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Da Kangyi was a man of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 開泰間，累官南府宰相，出知黃龍府，善綏撫，東部懷服。

translations.literal: During Kaitai he rose through several offices to Chancellor of the Southern Administration and went out to govern Huanglong Prefecture; he was skilled at pacification, and the eastern tribes submitted in their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaitai era he rose through several offices to Chancellor of the Southern Administration and went out to govern Huanglong Prefecture. He was skilled at pacification, and the eastern tribes submitted in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 榆裏底乃部長伯陰與榆烈比來附，送於朝。

translations.literal: Boyin, chief of the Yulidi Nai tribe, and Yuliebi came to submit and were sent to court.
translations.idiomatic: Boyin, chief of the Yulidi Nai tribe, and Yuliebi came to submit and were sent to court.

sentences.zh: 且言蒲盧毛朵界多渤海人，乞取之。

translations.literal: He also said that within the borders of the Pulü Maoduo there were many people of Bohai and requested that they be taken.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that many Bohai people lived within the borders of Pulü Maoduo and asked that they be brought over.

sentences.zh: 詔從其請。

translations.literal: An edict followed his request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted his request.

sentences.zh: 康乂領兵至大石河駝準城，掠數百戶以歸。

translations.literal: Kangyi led troops to Tuozhun City on the Dashi River, carried off several hundred households, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Kangyi led troops to Tuozhun City on the Dashi River, carried off several hundred households, and returned.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：高句驪弒其君誦而立詢，遼興問罪之師，宜其簞食壺漿以迎，除舍以待；

translations.literal: The commentary says: Gaogouli murdered its lord Song and installed Sun; Liao raised an army to call them to account—they ought to have welcomed our troops with baskets of food and jars of drink and cleared lodgings to receive us;
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Gaogouli murdered King Song and installed Sun. Liao raised an army to call them to account. They ought to have welcomed our troops with baskets of food and jars of drink and cleared lodgings to receive us;

sentences.zh: 而乃乘險旅拒，俾智者竭其謀，勇者窮其力。

translations.literal: yet instead they held difficult terrain and resisted stubbornly, making the wise exhaust their stratagems and the brave spend their strength.
translations.idiomatic: yet instead they held difficult terrain and resisted stubbornly, making the wise exhaust their stratagems and the brave spend their strength.

sentences.zh: 雖得其要領，而端端獨居一海之中自若也。

translations.literal: Although the essentials were taken, they remained at ease, alone in their realm amid the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Although the essentials were seized, they remained at ease, alone in their realm amid the sea.

sentences.zh: 豈服人者以德而不以力歟？

translations.literal: Is it not that those who submit to others do so by virtue rather than by force?
translations.idiomatic: Is it not that those who win submission do so through virtue rather than through force?

sentences.zh: 況乎殘毀其宮室，系累其民人，所謂以燕伐燕也歟？

translations.literal: Moreover, to ruin their palaces and bind their people—what is this but the proverb of using Yan to attack Yan?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, to ruin their palaces and bind their people—what is this but the proverb of using Yan to attack Yan?

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 朱崖之棄，捐之之力也，敵烈之諫有焉。

translations.literal: The abandonment of Zhuya was the force of Juanzhi; in Dilie's remonstrance there was wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: The abandonment of Zhuya was the work of Juanzhi; in Dilie's remonstrance there was wisdom.
